sponsoredBills.summary: Under the Medicaid program, this bill would require states to reimburse eligible entities for patient navigator services provided to Medicaid-eligible individuals. sponsoredBills.summary: The bill would repeal section 230 of the Communications Act of 1934, which currently provides liability protections for online platforms and interactive computer services. The repeal would take effect two years after enactment, with conforming amendments made to related federal statutes.
sponsoredBills.title: Sunset Section 230 Act
